# Dependencies

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### External services

| Service | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Merchant-configured webhook (`config.webhookUrl`) | Receives lead payload `POST` before WhatsApp redirect (`src/integrations/webhook.js`) |
| WhatsApp (`wa.me`) | Terminal redirect target for the qualified lead conversation (`src/core/whatsapp.js:buildWhatsappUrl`) |
| Google Tag Manager (`window.dataLayer`) | Consumes `wpp_qualificacao_inicio`/`wpp_qualificacao_concluida` events for funnel tracking (`src/integrations/gtm.js`, README "Tagueamento e Métricas") |
| Cloudflare Pages/Workers | Hosts the built static bundle (`whatsapp-widget.js`, `whatsapp-widget.css`), SPA fallback, `nodejs_compat` (`wrangler.jsonc`) |

### Internal libraries

No private/first-party npm packages — this is a single-package repo (`package.json` name `whatsapp-lead`, `"private": true`); `src/core/`, `src/ui/`, `src/integrations/` are internal modules, not published packages.

### Shared infrastructure

None observed — no queue, broker, cache server, or observability/APM SDK in `package.json` dependencies; `wrangler.jsonc` enables `observability.enabled: true` for Cloudflare's built-in Workers logging only, with no additional client wiring in `src/`.

### Build/dev/test dependencies (all `devDependencies`, `package.json` — no runtime `dependencies`)

| Package | Version | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `vite` | `^6.0.0` | Bundles `src/index.js` into IIFE `whatsapp-widget.js` (`vite.config.js`) |
| `@cloudflare/vite-plugin` | `^1.33.1` | Vite integration for Cloudflare Workers/Pages dev/build |
| `wrangler` | `^4.84.1` | Cloudflare CLI: `npm run deploy` / `npm run preview` |
| `vitest` | `^2.0.0` | Unit test runner (`tests/unit`) |
| `jsdom` | `^24.1.0` | DOM environment for vitest unit tests (`vitest.config.js`) |
| `@playwright/test` | `^1.44.0` | Integration/e2e test runner (`tests/integration`) |
| `eslint` | `^9.25.1` | Linter (`npm run lint`) |
| `@eslint/js` | `^9.25.1` | ESLint recommended rule set (`eslint.config.js`) |
